title: relay drops the issues and product plugins
what: relay keeps only the plugins relay itself uses (core, delegate, front, observe) plus openspec; the issues and product plugins, setup's flags and code paths that turn them on, their tests and docs go; nothing else changes. Queue items that only make sense with them are dropped with a reason when this lands: setup-never-sees-a-phoenix-project-as-person-fac, issues-flow-in..., issue-bindings....
why: Owner, 27 Oct small hours: "Хочу убрать плагины которые не используются самим relay, кроме openspec". Facts that night: relay's own sessions enable core, delegate, front and observe (global settings); plugins/issues holds skills create, implement, merge, read and flow.json (87 lines); plugins/product holds the ui-reviewer agent, the look-review skill and scripts/measure.mjs (a Node script; relay uses bun, not Node); lib/relay_setup.py turns them on through the issues flow and --product. Git history keeps both. Build before the-core-plugin-becomes-relay-amidman (both change marketplace.json and setup). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
